cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field in manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status, as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Preferred Requirements
Work on personal or extracurricular projects
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value creating work that has a meaningful and positive effect on others. We believe fairness, respect, and responsibility should guide how we operate.
cond_0001.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, please apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0118.requirements:
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language

cond_0172.intro:
[Company name masked] is a defense technology company. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, [Company name masked] is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. [Company name masked]'s family of systems is powered by [Product name masked], an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufacturing or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0172.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0172.requirements:
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language

The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work closely and regularly with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work hands-on with technicians and other engineers daily, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures — staying in regular contact with supplier teams throughout
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
U.S. Person status, as this position needs to access export controlled data
Preferred Requirements
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring of SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review experience
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

cond_0239.intro:

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, [Company name masked] is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. [Company name masked]'s family of systems is powered by [Product name masked], an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment. People tend to grow stronger in this kind of manufacturing work over time as they build hands-on experience and learn from real production challenges.
cond_0383.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0383.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field in manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status, as this position needs to access export controlled data
Preferred Requirements
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
Work on personal or extracurricular projects
cond_0383.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
cond_0383.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, women are especially encouraged to apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong. Confidence can sometimes hold women back from applying for a job. But here's a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. [Company name masked] is a place where every woman can grow and succeed. So, whatever your background and wherever you come from, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

[Company name masked]'s family of systems is powered by [Product name masked], an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility covers everything in the manufacturing value chain, including Design for Manufacturability work, tool design and selection, process creation and optimization, vendor sourcing, quality planning, and work documentation for the hardware the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership of a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0412.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a given product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Coordinate with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to carry out initial sourcing work, resolve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0412.requirements:
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus
cond_0412.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0412.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

cond_0434.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufacturing or oversaw manufacturing on, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.
cond_0434.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0434.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware.
Proven track record of creatively delivering electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment.
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples.
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.).
U.S. Person status, as this position needs to access export controlled data.
Preferred Requirements
Extensive PCBA fabrication experience, including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring of SMT processes.
Deep knowledge of harness or PCBA design or design review.
Solid hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems.
Proficiency in software scripting in any language.
Work on personal or extracurricular projects.

We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0451.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field in manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status, as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Preferred Requirements
Work on personal or extracurricular projects
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, [Company name masked] is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. [Company name masked]'s family of systems is powered by [Product name masked], an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufacturing or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0478.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0478.requirements:
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
cond_0478.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0478.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, women are especially encouraged to apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong. Confidence can sometimes hold women back from applying for a job. But here's a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. [Company name masked] is a place where every woman can grow and succeed. So, whatever your background and wherever you come from, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical, solution that they either personally manufacturing or oversaw manufacturing on, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.
cond_0525.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to do initial sourcing work, solve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0525.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science, or equivalent practical experience
Around 2 years of experience in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and training — manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware is a plus
Some background in delivering electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment, with a creative approach to problem-solving
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware by any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) — personal or extracurricular projects count
A genuine interest in manufacturing and willingness to keep learning
U.S. Person status, as this position requires access to export controlled data
Preferred Requirements
Some experience with in-kind or direct team leadership, with examples to share
Familiarity with PCBA fabrication, including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring of SMT processes
Background in harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Exposure to software scripting in any language
cond_0525.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.

[Company name masked]'s family of systems is powered by [Product name masked], an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, [Company name masked] is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
[Company name masked]'s Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer focused on Avionics. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, and flight vehicles. This responsibility covers everything in the manufacturing value chain, including Design for Manufacturability work, tool design and selection, process creation and optimization, vendor sourcing, quality planning, and work documentation for the hardware the Manufacturing Engineer owns.
The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership of a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw manufacturing on, in a resource-limited environment.
cond_0592.responsibilities:
Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a given product or set of products
Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
Coordinate with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
Troubleshoot and root cause investigations of system level and piece part electrical failures
Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware
Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
Travel to suppliers to carry out initial sourcing work, resolve ongoing production issues, and implement quality procedures
cond_0592.requirements:
Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
2+ Years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
Demonstrated ability to deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment
Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples
Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.)
A genuine interest in manufacturing and thirst for learning
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
PCBA fabrication experience including prior work with or setup/modification/monitoring SMT processes
Harness or PCBA design or design review
Hands-on experience with R/C and/or autonomous flight vehicles, flight controllers, or other related control systems
Software scripting experience in any language
Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus
cond_0592.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0592.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, women are especially encouraged to apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat.
